project_type: Python FastAPI async web application (DevSecOps vulnerability scanner)
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio, in-memory SQLite DB via conftest.py fixtures
verification_instructions: 1. Run lint: /root/.pyenv/versions/3.11.15/bin/python -m ruff check app/ tests/ 2. Run tests: /root/.pyenv/versions/3.11.15/bin/python -m pytest -q 3. Ensure all 123+ tests pass
setup_instructions: Python 3.11 is already installed at /root/.pyenv/versions/3.11.15/bin/python. Dependencies already installed.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network. Use /root/.pyenv/versions/3.11.15/bin/python for all commands.
contribution_requirements: Tests must pass. Lint must pass.
key_patterns: FSM states defined as FSMState enum in orchestrator.py. TRANSITIONS dict defines valid forward transitions. _maybe_advance_state() maps tool_name to a target state and advances one step. _advance_to_complete() walks the full chain to COMPLETE. The job.status DB column stores the FSM state string. The front end template job_detail.html reads job.status and renders a pipeline stepper comparing each state index to current_index. The polling JS reloads the page when status changes.
directory_structure: app/ - main application (FastAPI), app/services/ - business logic including orchestrator FSM, app/templates/ - Jinja2 HTML templates, app/routers/ - API and HTML routes, tests/ - pytest test files
